title: Police Blotter: 29 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 29 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and federal holds in the day leading up to Saturday night, Oct. 24, 2026 — including 10 alleged DWI bookings. An arrest is an allegation; all are presumed innocent.
content:
